integrity: Proof and finite independent-cycle numerical checks are included; no claim of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact model has free passive overdamped motion, positive-definite constant body mobility, instantaneous Poisson orientation resets, no position resets, no interactions.

The universal threshold concerns the coupling-induced excess covariance after removing the Schur-complement thermal contribution; only in isotropic Schur subclasses is it automatically the total-covariance threshold.
Stochastic resetting and mobility noise are assumed independent; finite-duration actuation is excluded.
General regenerative fluctuation theory is prior mathematics; only the specific covariance and the mode-order crossover are at issue.
title: Universal Poisson-reset crossover in chiral-colloid excess dispersion
